selection_reasoning: These four tasks form a coherent multi-hop exploration and interaction sequence. The scene can be designed as a path through different biome-themed areas. The player first needs to 'find gravel' which is placed near an elevated sandstone structure. Upon finding the gravel area, the player can locate and 'mine sandstone_wall' from an adjacent sandstone structure (the gravel naturally occurs near sandstone/desert biomes, making this a logical spatial dependency). After mining the sandstone wall, the player is on an elevated platform from which they must 'fall' down to a lower water/swamp area. After falling, they land near a pond where they 'find lily_pad' to complete the sequence. This creates a natural spatial progression: gravel area → sandstone structure (mine wall) → fall off structure → pond with lily pads.

Mining the sandstone wall opens access to/destabilizes the elevated platform edge, causing the player to fall
Falling from the sandstone platform lands the player in the lower pond area where lily pads are located

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate gravel. The gravel patch is centered at (6.5, -1, 6.5) spawn-relative, which is ~9.2 blocks from spawn. max_distance=6 requires the player to actually walk toward the gravel patch (they must be within 6 horizontal blocks of the center). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the gravel, confirming they found it.

Uses inventory_has because mining sandstone_wall with a pickaxe drops the sandstone_wall item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no sandstone_wall in inventory (only a wooden pickaxe is given), so having at least 1 sandstone_wall confirms successful mining. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.

Uses position_inside_box because the sand pit at (13-15, -5 to -3, -2 to 8) spawn-relative is ONLY reachable by falling from the structure top — it is enclosed by sand walls on 3 sides and the sandstone structure wall on the 4th side, with no walking path into it. The pit floor is at y=-5 and the structure top is at y=3, creating a 7-block fall. Being inside this box proves the player fell from the structure. The box is generous vertically (-5 to -3) to catch the player at any point in the pit.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate lily pads on the pond. The lily pads are clustered around (-6, 0, -6) spawn-relative on the water pond surface. max_distance=10 requires the player to navigate toward the pond (it's ~8.5 blocks from spawn, so they must move in that direction). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the lily pads, confirming visual discovery.

scene_description: A sandstone structure (4 blocks tall) with decorative sandstone_wall blocks on the rim, accessible via sandstone stairs. A gravel patch is placed adjacent to the structure's south side. On the east side of the structure, a deep pit (sand floor at y=-5) creates a fall zone only accessible by jumping/falling off the structure's east edge. A water pond with lily pads is located in the southwest (-X/-Z) direction from spawn. The player progresses: find gravel near structure → climb stairs and mine sandstone_wall from top → fall off east edge into pit → navigate to pond to find lily_pads.
task_text: Navigate to the gravel patch near the sandstone structure. Climb the structure using the stairs and mine a sandstone wall block from the top. Fall off the east edge into the sand pit below. Then find the lily pads on the pond to the southwest.
design_notes: Layout: Player spawns at (0,0,0). Gravel at (5-8,-1,5-8). Sandstone structure at (6-12, 0-3, -2 to 8) with hollow interior. Sandstone_wall decorative blocks at y=3 on all four edges. Stairs on west side (x=5, z=3-5) ascending from y=0 to y=2 to allow climbing. East side pit (x=13-15, y=-5 to -1, z=-2 to 8) filled with sand at bottom — only reachable by falling from structure top (7-block fall). Water pond at (-10 to -3, -1, -10 to -3) with 5 lily pads on surface. The fall pit has sand walls on all sides so the player must have fallen from above to be inside it.
